The '''dusty dazzler''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] that had a liquidized form intended to maximize liquid [[Diet/Legends|intake]]. This was primarily due to the extreme [[Temperature/Legends|heat]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which was caused by its [[Binary star system/Legends|twin]] [[Star/Legends|suns]], [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]]. Like the [[ruby bliel]] and [[galaxy guzzler]], it was one of several liquid foods that could be made of a mixture of liquidized [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] or [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] as well as [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="FF131" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dusty dazzler was mentioned in issue [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 131|131]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine, which was<ref name="FF131" /> written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> published by [[De Agostini]] around [[June 30]], [[2004]].<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|131}}</ref>
